page.layout: One column of text, with the page number and running head at the top. Five numbered epitaphs run down the page. The catchword "Vrbs" stands at the right below the last line.

main_text.p: IUNCTIS CUM HENRICO VIII. An-glorum rege viribus, iterum ad vicum Guyne-gatam, locū antiqua Cæsaris victoria fatalem, insigni prælio[?] profligatus Gallorum exercitus,
TEROVANNA MORINORUM EX-cisa, Tornacum vero prisca bellicosi ac fortif-simi Nerviorum populi gloriæ insignis civitas, post levem oppugnationem in fidem accepta.
BARTHOLOMÆUS LIVIANUS, EX-celsi nominis dux, cum ingenti Venetarum copiarum apparatu a parva Cæsarianorum militum Germanorum ac Hispanorum manu prope Vicentiam fusus & fugatus.
MARANUM OPPIDUM ASTU CA-ptum, obsidentibusq; id paulo post Venetis, e-ruptione inde facta, cum Paulo Manfronno & Balthasaro Scipione, acerrimis hostium duci-bus, feliciter pugnatum.
CONVENTU CUM HUNGARIÆ AC Poloniæ regibus Viennæ habito, contractisq; hinc inde matrimoniis, nepotibus ipsius via acquirendis amplissimis Hungariæ ac Bohemiæ regnis strata.

page.notes: Printed hyphens kept at line ends (An-, Guyne-, EX-, fortif-, CA-, e-, duci-). Doubtful: "prælio" in the epitaph XIX line, where the first letters are blurred. Ligatures such as ct and ꝑ are expanded in plain letters where clear. Long s is written as s throughout. The number "XXI." is treated as a bare numeral paragraph, not a heading.
